title: FUNCTIONAL SERICULTURE INDUSTRY FOSTERAGE AND SUPPORT ACT
title_original: 기능성 양잠산업 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률
full_text:
FUNCTIONAL SERICULTURE INDUSTRY FOSTERAGE AND SUPPORT ACT

 

 
 Act No. 19109, Dec. 27, 2022 

 

 

 

 Act No. 9726, May 27, 2009

 

 

Amended by Act No. 11690, Mar. 23, 2013

 

 
Act No. 15381, Feb. 21, 2018

 

 
Act No. 17313, May 26, 2020

 

 
Act No. 19109, Dec. 27, 2022

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
법령보기 화면

 

 

 
 Article 1 (Purpose)

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
The purpose of this Act is to plan increase in income of farm households and to contribute to national health and economic development through the promotion and development of the functional sericulture industry by prescribing matters necessary for the continuous development of the functional sericulture industry and for the establishment of stable foundation for sericulture.

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
법령보기 화면

 

 

 
 Article 2 (Definitions)

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
The terms used in this Act are defined as follows: <Amended on Dec. 27, 2022>
1.
 The term "functional sericulture industry" means an industry in the following items:
a.
 An industry that produces (including processing; hereafter in this Article the same shall apply) silkworms, mulberry trees, cocoons, mulberries, mulberry leaves, or other products prescribed by Presidential Decree, or by-products of each thereof, for use in foods or materials that have beneficial effects on the human body;
b.
 An industry that produces foods or materials that have beneficial effects on the human body from silkworms, mulberry trees, cocoons, mulberries, mulberry leaves, or other products prescribed by Presidential Decree, or by-products of each thereof;
c.
 An industry for the purposes of wholesaling or retailing the products referred to in item a or by-products of each thereof, or the foods or materials referred to in item b (hereinafter referred to as "sericulture products, etc."), and of storage, delivery, and packaging for operating such businesses, as well as the provision of information and services related thereto;
d.
 Any other industry related to sericulture products, etc. as prescribed by Presidential Decree;
2.
 The term "functional silkworm cultivating households" means households engaged in the functional sericulture industry.
Article 3
 (Responsibilities of the State and Local Governments
(1)
 The State and local governments shall formulate and implement policy measures necessary to ensure the sustainable growth of the functional sericulture industry and the stable establishment of functional sericulture farms. <Amended on Dec. 27, 2022>
(2)
 In establishing measures under paragraph (1), the State and local governments shall prepare the measures of administrative and financial support necessary for the stable settlement of functional silkworm cultivating households.
(3)
 Functional silkworm cultivating households shall endeavor to advance the functional sericulture industry and to foster and develop eco-friendly silkworms and cultivated crops. <Amended on May 26, 2020>

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
법령보기 화면

 

 

 
 Article 4 (Relationship to other statutes)

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
Unless otherwise provided in other statutes, this Act shall apply to the fostering and support of the functional sericulture industry and functional silkworm cultivating households.

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
법령보기 화면

 

 

 
 Article 5 (Establishment of comprehensive plan)

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
(1)
 For the continuous growth of the functional sericulture industry and the stable settlement of functional silkworm cultivating households, the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall establish a comprehensive plan to foster the functional sericulture industry (hereinafter referred to as "comprehensive plans") every five years after consultation with the heads of related central administrative agencies. <Amended on Mar. 23, 2013>
(2)
 The comprehensive plan shall include the following matters: <Amended on May 26, 2020; Dec. 27, 2022>
1.
 Present status of the functional sericulture industry and prospect therefor;
2.
 Direction of support and objective of the functional sericulture industry;
3.
 Strategy of support for the promotion of economic vitality of the functional sericulture industry;
4.
 Long-term and mid-term investment plans to support the functional sericulture industry;
5.
 Technical education of functional sericulture and plans to foster support personnel;
6.
 Matters related to research, development, and dissemination of technologies related to the functional sericulture industry;
7.
 Measures to support projects related to the functional sericulture industry by local governments;
8.
 Other matters deemed necessary for the development of the functional sericulture industry.
(3)
 When establishing comprehensive plans, the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall have such plans deliberated upon by the central deliberation committee of agriculture, rural community and food industry under 
Article 15 of the Framework Act on Agriculture
, Rural Community and Food Industry. <Amended on Dec. 27, 2022.>
(4)
 For the implementation of the comprehensive plan, the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall formulate and implement an annual implementation plan (hereinafter referred to as the "implementation plan") each year after hearing the opinions of the heads of relevant central administrative agencies, as prescribed by Presidential Decree. <Added on Dec. 27, 2022>
(5)
 The Administrator of the Rural Development Administration shall formulate and implement annual detailed promotion plans of the implementation plan. <Added on Dec. 27, 2022>
(6)
 The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall evaluate each year the results of implementation under the implementation plan. <Added on Dec. 27, 2022>
(7)
 The Administrator of the Rural Development Administration shall evaluate each year the results of implementation under the annual detailed promotion plans and submit the results to the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs. <Added on Dec. 27, 2022>
(8)
 If necessary for the formulation and implementation of the comprehensive plan or implementation plan, or for the evaluation of implementation results under the implementation plan, the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may request the heads of relevant agencies to submit data; in such cases, the person requested to submit data shall comply with the request unless there is good cause not to do so. <Added on Dec. 27, 2022>
(9)
 Matters necessary for the formulation and implementation of the comprehensive plan and implementation plan, and for the evaluation of implementation results under the implementation plan shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree. <Added on Dec. 27, 2022>
[Title Amended on Dec. 27, 2022]

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
법령보기 화면

 

 

 
 Article 6 (Fact-finding surveys)

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
(1)
 In order to efficiently establish and promote comprehensive plans and to build stable foundations for the self-sustenance of functional silkworm cultivating households, the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may conduct a fact-finding survey on the state, etc. of the functional sericulture industry. <Amended on Mar. 23, 2013>
(2)
 Where necessary for a fact-finding survey under paragraph (1), the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may request research institutions, organizations, etc. to submit data or to state opinions. <Amended on Mar. 23, 2013>
(3)
 Research institutions, organizations, etc. requested to submit data or to state opinions under paragraph (2) shall cooperate with such requests unless any extenuating circumstance exists.
(4)
 The extent and method of a fact-finding survey under paragraph (1), and other necessary matters shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
법령보기 화면

 

 

 
 Article 7 (Performance of functional sericulture duties by local governments)

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
(1)
 The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may allow the heads of local governments to engage in the following activities in order to disseminate technologies necessary for the seed industry to strike root stably: <Amended on Mar. 3, 2013; May 26, 2020>
1.
 Collection of information necessary for the dissemination of functional sericulture technology;
2.
 Performance of education projects and experience projects relating to functional sericulture;
3.
 Counseling on the types of silkworms and cultivated crops necessary for functional sericulture, methods of their cultivation, etc.;
4.
 Installation and operation of education programs of functional sericulture technology;
5.
 Other projects delegated by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.
(2)
 The State may subsidize funds within budget limits in order to efficiently perform the projects under paragraph (1).

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
법령보기 화면

 

 

 
 Article 8 (Promotion of technology development)

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
(1)
 The State or local governments shall endeavor to develop technology for the promotion of the functional sericulture industry.
(2)
 The State or local governments may assist those who research and develop, or industrialize technology, etc. in order to promote technology development under paragraph (1).

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
법령보기 화면

 

 

 
 Article 9 (Assistance to functional sericulture industry)

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
The State and local governments may provide necessary support for the following matters to promote the functional sericulture industry: <Amended on Dec. 27, 2022>
1.
 Facilities and equipment necessary for the functional sericulture industry, and processing facilities for sericulture products, etc.;
2.
 Overseas production sites relating to the functional sericulture industry;
3.
 The functional sericulture industry succeeding to the spirit of the traditional industry relating to sericulture.
4.
 Farms, producer organizations, and processing businesses that export sericulture products, etc.

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
법령보기 화면

 

 

 
 Article 9-2 (Development of excellent silkworm varieties)

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may establish and implement policies regarding the development of excellent silkworm varieties and the production and supply of high-quality silkworm eggs to promote the functional sericulture industry, as prescribed by Presidential Decree.
[This Article Added on Dec. 27, 2022]

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
법령보기 화면

 

 

 
 Article 9-3 (Training of specialized human resources)

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
(1)
 The State and local governments shall train specialized human resources necessary for the fostering and support of the functional sericulture industry.
(2)
 For the training of specialized human resources under paragraph (1), the State and local governments may designate universities under 
Article 2 of the Higher Education Act
, or research institutes, institutions, or organizations established for purposes such as research activities related to the functional sericulture industry, as training institutions for specialized human resources and have them conduct necessary education and training.
(3)
 The State and local governments may grant a subsidy to an expert training institution designated pursuant to paragraph (2) to help cover all or part of the expenses incurred in education and training, as prescribed by Presidential Decree.
(4)
 Where a training institution for specialized human resources no longer meets the designation criteria under paragraph (5), the State and local governments may revoke its designation: In such cases, a hearing shall be held.
(5)
 Matters necessary for the designation criteria, operation, and revocation of designation of training institutions for specialized human resources shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.
[This Article Added on Dec. 27, 2022]

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
법령보기 화면

 

 

 
 Article 9-4 (Sericulturists' Day)

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
(1)
 In order to inform the public of the tradition and value of the functional sericulture industry and to enhance the pride and self-esteem of persons engaged in the functional sericulture industry (hereinafter referred to as "sericulturists"), May 10 of each year shall be designated as Sericulturists' Day.
(2)
 The State and local governments shall endeavor to conduct events, education, and publicity consistent with the purpose of Sericulturists' Day under paragraph (1).
[This Article Added on Dec. 27, 2022]

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
법령보기 화면

 

 

 
 Article 10 (Management of functional silkworm cultivating households)

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
In order to efficiently implement policies for fostering and supporting functional sericulture farm households, the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may have functional sericulture farm households register information related to functional sericulture management under 
Article 40 of the Framework Act on Agriculture
, Rural Community and Food Industry and 
Article 4(1) of the Act on Fostering and Supporting Agricultural and Fisheries Business Entities
. <Amended on Mar. 23, 2013, Dec. 27, 2022>

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
법령보기 화면

 

 

 
 Article 11 (Delegation and entrustment of authority)

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
Part of the authority of the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs under this Act may be delegated or entrusted to the heads of affiliated agencies, related institutions or organizations, as prescribed by Presidential Decree. <Amended on Mar. 23, 2013>

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
법령보기 화면

 

 

 
 Article 12 (Legal fiction as public officials for purposes of applying penalty provisions)

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
The executive officers and employees of institutions or organizations engaged in the business affairs entrusted by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs pursuant to 
Article 11
 shall be deemed public officials for purposes of applying the penalty provisions under 
Articles 129 through 132 of the Criminal Act
.
[This Article Added on Feb. 21, 2018]

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
ADDENDUM<Act No. 9726, May 27, 2009>

 
This Act shall enter into force six months after the date of its promulgation.

 This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
(2)

Articles 2
